text: SELECT molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, drug_indication.mesh_heading, drug_indication.mesh_id, drug_indication.efo_term, drug_indication.efo_id FROM molecule_dictionary JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno JOIN drug_indication ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno WHERE molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 AND drug_indication.mesh_id LIKE 'D%'
